title: FRED Market Fear Gauges
description: Tracks market stress and fear indicators: VIX (equity volatility), high-yield credit spreads (ICE BofA), investment-grade credit spreads, TED spread (interbank stress), and the St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index. Credit spreads widening means institutional investors are pricing in default risk - historically the most reliable crisis signal. VIX spikes above 30 indicate panic selling; sustained spreads above 500bps preceded both 2008 and 2020 crashes.
